announcements.body: Welcome to the Academy's announcements. Course updates, corrections, and school news will be posted here and on each course's page, in its Course updates section. Instructors: to announce something to your enrolled students, email the text to support at planetleads1@gmail.com and it will be posted here.
announcements.title: Announcements are live

note: Planet Leads Academy announcements. One entry per announcement, newest first. 'course' is a course slug (e.g. 'python') for a course-specific announcement, or null for school-wide news shown on every course page. Edit this one file to publish; announcements.js renders it on announcements.html and on each course page. Created with Planet Leads 🚀
